title: Yearbook and Prom
author: Isandro Montrose
blurb: Jude Thackeray, the team's statistician who knows the game is rigged, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. Then a group chat starts predicting things that haven't happened yet — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must save the tradition that made the town, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
